description: List the saved versions of an agent's settings, newest first: what saved each one (source), what changed (diff_summary), who (created_by) and which version a rollback came from. Secrets are never included. Pass `version` to fetch one version's full saved settings (config_snapshot). That snapshot holds the compiled prompt; to edit the prompt, read get_agent_config instead.

limit.description: Max versions to return when listing (optional, default 50, max 100).

version.description: Fetch a single version by its per-agent version_number, including its redacted config_snapshot (optional; omit to list).

name: list_config_versions
title: List Agent Config Versions
